title: Eligible population
one_line_definition: Displays the total count of eligible members formatted for readability, scaling to K, M, or bn depending on magnitude.
numerator_meaning: Total count of eligible members across all flag values with no flag filter applied.
result_meaning: The total number of members who are eligible for risk adjustment consideration in the selected period.

measure_meanings.Formatted Eligible population: Displays the eligible member count scaled and formatted as a whole number, K, M, or bn depending on its size.
measure_meanings.ELigible population YoY Card: Shows the year-over-year percentage change in the eligible population count compared to the same period last year, displayed as an up or down arrow with a percentage.
